role_input: Task: Add Prime Minister Trudeau's tenure range to the actor_tenures.json file.
bad_output:
SOURCE: general knowledge
QUOTE: Justin Trudeau was Prime Minister from 2015 to 2025.
GAP_FILLED: Can now add the tenure row.
correct_output:
SOURCE: Canada Gazette OIC notice 2015-11-04 (appointment) and PMO transition announcement 2025-03-14 (resignation)
QUOTE: 'Justin Trudeau, sworn in as Prime Minister on November 4, 2015' (PMO) and 'Prime Minister Trudeau resigned effective March 14, 2025' (PMO transition announcement 2025-03-14).
GAP_FILLED: Gives the tenure a primary-source anchor for both start and end dates.
annotation: 'General knowledge' is never an acceptable SOURCE. Every fact must be anchored to a specific retrievable document: Canada Gazette OIC, Hansard column, court cite (CanLII format), officer report URL, or the target file's existing content. Synthetic example to teach the role never to accept 'general' as a valid anchor.

role_input: Engineer proposed adding a consequence field: 'PM Trudeau was fined $50,000 under s.52 after the SNC-Lavalin finding.'
bad_output:
CHECK_CITATIONS: OK
CHECK_LINKS: OK
CHECK_A11Y: n/a
OVERALL: CLEAN
correct_output:
CHECK_CITATIONS: FAIL — the Conflict of Interest Act's s.52 administrative monetary penalty does NOT apply to s.9 contraventions. The Trudeau II finding was of s.9 only. Therefore no $50,000 fine was imposed. This claim is fabricated.
CHECK_LINKS: OK
CHECK_A11Y: n/a
OVERALL: NEEDS_REWORK
annotation: Editor must know the Conflict of Interest Act section-to-penalty mapping. s.52 AMPs apply to specific sections only (s.11, s.17, s.22, s.23, s.25, s.27); not to s.5, s.9, s.12, s.21. Claims about fines must match this mapping. Synthetic negative to build editor's statutory literacy.
